qso-reports.title: Give the reports
qso-reports.prompt: Pick the right report each time.

config.setting: 20 m and the local repeater. You're VE3HAM.

turns.situation: SSB: you copy VE2XYZ perfectly. Your S-meter reads S7. Your report?

options.feedback: S7 is moderately strong, not S9.

turns.situation: CW: perfectly readable, moderately strong, and a perfect tone.
On the repeater, a station 80 km away asks how they sound.

options.text: Report their signal and audio as heard through the repeater
Read your S-meter on the repeater output
options.feedback: That's the repeater's signal, not theirs.

options.text: Read your S-meter on the repeater input
options.feedback: You may not hear them on the input at all. Report what you hear through the repeater.

turns.situation: A very faint SSB signal you can barely detect and can't understand.

options.feedback: Readability, strength, tone: you can give a report for anything you hear.
3 3 is readable with considerable difficulty. You can't read this at all.
5 is perfectly readable, which this isn't.

qso-reports.success: Readability, strength, tone: you can give a report for anything you hear.
